1.consolidated_definition: Dicho o hecho con la intención de adular.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Done with flattery; said or done with the intention of flattering.

Alternatively:

 Said or done with the intention to ingratiate oneself.

Or:

 Done or said in order to curry favor.
